basic_details.job_title: IIITM Gwalior Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Research Assistant/Intern Posts
basic_details.short_information: Atal Bihari Vajpayee-Indian Institute of Information Technology & Management, Gwalior (IIITM Gwalior) has invited online applications for the Research Assistant/Intern post under a project-based engagement. The position is initially for a period of six months with a specified pay of Rs. 18,000 per month. Applicants must hold a B.Tech./UG in any area related to the project to be eligible. Interested candidates can complete the online application process on or before 29 October 2026. The selection process involves screening of applications, shortlisting, and an interview of shortlisted candidate

important_dates.application deadline: 29/10/2026 (10 days from the date of advertisement)
important_dates.interview_date: Not specified (Only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email regarding the next stage of the process)

how_to_apply: Candidates are requested to fill in the form here: https://forms.gle/PGWeC29NDD1tD3AZ7.
Ensure complete documents and information are provided, as incomplete form/missing documents will result in the candidature not being considered.
Submit the application form within 10 days from the date of advertisement (29/10/2026).
important_instructions: Incomplete form/missing documents, the candidature will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed through email for the next stage of the process. For any query, please email Dr. Vivek Tiwari [email protected]. The candidates will be required to give progress details to the investigators on a regular basis. The position will initially be for a period of six months and may be renewed quarterly (every three months) based on monthly performance, availability of the fund and subject to the project’s duration. Position can be terminated at any point of time.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Candidates should be either pursuing or should completed B.Tech./UG in any area related to the project.
rows.desirable_qualification: -Candidates with hands-on experience in Python/C++, OpenCV, PyTorch/TensorFlow, ROS/ROS2, embedded systems, robotics, CAD, and autonomous navigation. -Internship experience with research/sponsored projects shall be preferred. -may require travelling for the data collection and filed testing.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Research Assistant/Intern will receive a stipend of ₹ 18,000 per month (including all deduction if any) subject to monthly progress assessment. The authority reserves the right to reduce, withhold, or terminate the stipend. The position will initially be for a period of six months and may be renewed quarterly (every three months) based on monthly performance, availability of the fund and subject to the project’s duration. Position can be terminated at any point of time.

content_sections.heading: IIITM Gwalior Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The intern will be involved in the development and integration of an AI-enabled autonomous agricultural robot, including robotic platform design and fabrication, computer vision and deep learning for weed/crop detection, sensor integration (IMU, LiDAR, stereo camera and encoders), robotic arm and end-effector control, autonomous navigation, sensor fusion, system calibration, and laboratory/field testing.

content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email regarding the next stage of the process and the date of interview.
